desc: Experience precision and speed with the new Straight Bolt rifles. Engineered for accuracy and built to last, these rifles are the perfect choice for target shooting, hunting, and beyond. Chambered in both 17HMR and 22WMR, the Straight Bolt delivers exceptional performance. Featuring a robust Hogue stock for comfort and control, a threaded 19″ barrel for customization, and an 20MOA picatinny base for quick scope mounting, this rifle is ready for any challenge. Built with the same precision and attention to detail as our renowned SwitchBolt semi-auto models, these bolt-action rifles offer a smooth, reliable operation. Discover the Straight Bolt advantage where accuracy meets speed!.
